description: This line plot illustrates the similarity of Hidden State Activations (HSAs) across different language pairs within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model, plotted against the layer number. The x-axis represents “Layer,” ranging from 0 to 22 in integer increments, indicating the depth of the model’s architecture. The y-axis represents “Similarity,” scaled linearly from 0.00 to 0.45, indicating the degree of semantic or structural overlap between the HSAs of the specified language pairs. Four distinct lines represent the similarity between different language pairs: the red solid line for “en&en” (English-English), the blue solid line for “en&es” (English-Spanish), the green solid line for “en&el” (English-Greek), and the pink solid line for “en&bn” (English-Bengali). All lines begin near a similarity of 0.05 at layer 0, with the red line rising sharply to a peak of approximately 0.26 at layer 6 before declining and stabilizing around 0.15–0.18 through layers 8–12. The lines then exhibit a general downward trend through layers 14–20, with all four lines dropping to a minimum near 0.04–0.05 around layer 20. From layer 22 onward, all lines experience a steep upward trend, with the red line reaching a final value of approximately 0.44, the pink line reaching approximately 0.30, and the blue and green lines reaching approximately 0.27 and 0.30, respectively.
